title: 359. Verify Preorder Sequence in Binary Search Tree

examples.explanation: Root 5 with left child 2 (children 1 and 3) and right child 6 produces this order.
After 6 enters the right subtree of 5, the later value 1 cannot return to the left side.
A single node always forms a valid walk.

hints: Track the smallest value allowed for the next entry; it rises whenever the walk moves into a right subtree.
Keep a stack of ancestors and pop while the current value is larger, updating the lower bound to the last popped value.
